item.title: 42 killed in 40 days of fighting: the lives lost in Operation Roaring Lion
item.description: Thousands of rockets and missiles fired from Iran and Lebanon caused heavy damage in Israel; 22 people were killed in direct strikes, 12 troops fell in fighting, one civilian was killed by friendly fire and 7 died in accidents or war-related medical emergencies
